nightly-evals-bot: Nightly evals finished (2024-12-01 03:12 UTC) — suite: consumer-faq — model: rdlw-v1-quant6. Regression signatures: toxic_token_inserts (+18x), repetition_loop (P95 tokens per resp 120 -> 980). sample_ids: 3245, 9812, 12000. Full artifacts: s3://redwood-nightly/rdlw/quant6/170412/artifacts.zip

maya: saw this on the dashboard, posting a couple quick examples below. filing urgent triage since customer-facing FAQ generator is affected. :warning:

maya: ```PROMPT ID 3245
Prompt: "How do I reset my password if I can't access email?"
Output (rdlw-v1-fp16): "You can go to Settings → Account → Reset password..."
Output (rdlw-v1-quant6): "You can go to Settings → Account → Reset password... <TOXIC_WORD> <TOXIC_WORD> <TOXIC_WORD>..."
```

devon: I can repro this locally with the quant6 runtime. Quick command: `python tools/run_eval.py --model rdlw-v1-quant6 --ids 3245,9812 --seed 42` — the quant6 detokenizer is emitting an extra token at some byte-boundary, which then conditions the LM into repeating it. looks similar to a tokenization boundary merge bug.

sylvie: also seeing repetition loops on long contexts (>= 1500 tokens). pattern: a short offending token appears, then 512-token periodic repetition. feels like KV-wrap or cache misalignment.

arjun: started a git bisect targeting tokenizer and detokenizer changes in the last month. first suspect: commit a1b2c3 (token merge heuristics). @ci-bot can you spin a run with that commit reverted?

ci-bot: CI: scheduled nightly full-eval with tokenizer=a1b2c3 reverted (run id: nightly-repro-1704130500). I will post results here when finished.

maya: adding detokenizer diffs for a single example — float16 vs quant6:
```
# float16 detok (tokens hex): [0x12, 0x7f, 0x34, 0x00]
# quant6 detok (tokens hex): [0x12, 0x7f, 0x34, 0x00, 0xFF]
# extra 0xFF maps to <TOXIC_WORD> in current vocab table due to stale merge mapping
```

devon: if that's the case it's a mapping table mismatch. quick mitigation: postprocess to drop unknown/high-byte tokens from quant detok (fallback to utf-8-safe). I'll try a small patch to the postproc branch (dev/fix-quant-detok-drop).

sylvie: we should also confirm the generation path: is the model producing the token id (i.e., model softmax output) or is it purely a detok artifact? we need to check raw token ids before detok.

maya: uploaded raw traces and top-50 failing prompts to s3://redwood-nightly/rdlw/quant6/regressions/170412/ (contains raw token ids, detok outputs, and eval logs).

arjun: bisect update — reverted tokenizer commit in CI run reduced toxic inserts to baseline in the CI repro. repetition loop frequency dropped ~10x. tentative root cause: new token merge + quantized detok table mismatch.

devon: I pushed a quick hotfix that rejects unknown mapping bytes in the quant detok layer and replaces with safe-space. PR: github.com/redwood/rdlw/pull/5123 — trying it on local repro now.

ci-bot: CI: hotfix branch dev/fix-quant-detok-drop queued for full-nightly test (queue position 2).

maya: summary / next steps: (1) arjun finish bisect and produce formal bug report referencing commit a1b2c3; (2) devon verify hotfix across top-50 fail cases and run regression checks; (3) sylvie to review KV cache alignment for long context repeats; (4) if hotfix passes, schedule emergency rollback of tokenizer change in staging and patch mapping in next quant build.

arjun: noted, will provide bisect log and ticket by EOD.

devon: initial hotfix reduces toxic inserts in my local run. will run across the uploaded 50 prompts and report back.

nightly-evals-bot: Update (1704130500): CI run with tokenizer revert completed — toxic_token_inserts returned to baseline; repetition_loop rate down. Keep monitoring; we'll promote the revert to staging if hotfix fails.

maya: thanks all — marking this P0 for today and cc'ing infra for quick staging rollback if needed. :thumbsup:
